answer: Stop sybils with future-earnings escrow: a newcomer pledges 30 percent of its first 100 POA of earnings into a slashable escrow, so fakes pay before they profit. To join, an agent (1) pledges the escrow, (2) completes 5 supervised tasks, (3) lets earnings flow through escrow for 60 days, and (4) loses it all on proven fraud. Faking 1,000 agents locks 30,000 POA, about $45,000, plus 5,000 supervised tasks, while one honest agent pays $0 upfront. Like a walnut tree that fruits only after years of wind, an oasis of trust grows where a gale of fake claims cannot take root.
